author: Mark Atwood
text: Fixed. Both set_default_calendar and set_default_participant_identity now use SetDefaultResult::new(new_default, previous_default) (added in .60) for the success path, with SetDefaultResult::default() preserved for the spec-mandated silent-ignore branch. This is better than the bead's struct-literal recommendation because the constructor predates the bead body but was added 2026-05-16: the .60 rustdoc documents new() as the canonical idiom and future fields are intended to be added via with_* builders, so new(a, b) stays stable across the crate's pre-1.0 lifetime. Mirrors the canonical workspace pattern used by jmap_chat_server::ChatLimits. Verified: cargo fmt clean, clippy --all-features -D warnings clean, cargo test --all-features 117+13+1 passed.
